parameters.jsCode: const rpc=JSON.parse($input.first().json.mcpRaw);if(rpc.error||rpc.result?.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(rpc.error||rpc.result));const res=rpc.result.structuredContent||JSON.parse(rpc.result.content.find(c=>c.type==='text').text);const c=res.data;if(c.companyId!=='Y45ERHZWGqYEslJF'||c.company?.name!=="Harry Rotolo's Company")throw Error('Unexpected Time Doctor company');if(c.readOnly!==true)throw Error('Expected read-only MCP connection');return [{json:{companyId:c.companyId,companyName:c.company.name,role:c.role,plan:c.company.plan,timezone:c.company.timezone,readOnly:c.readOnly}}];
